name: MTT Sports
summary:
This is a web-based Texas Hold'em poker game. Players can participate in free multi-table tournaments to get the platform's exclusive gaming currency—MTT TOKEN, which can be used to register for higher-level tournaments.
The game currently includes various formats such as No-Limit Texas Hold'em tournaments, Bounty Hunter tournaments, and Sit & Go (SNG) matches, while also providing access to real-time global player rankings.
